name: babvr-register-page-gateway
description: Gateway for the registration page of Build-A-Bearville Rewritten

scripts.build: pnpm run --filter babvr-register-page-backend build && pnpm run --filter babvr-register-page-frontend build && exit 0
scripts.lint: pnpm run --filter babvr-register-page-backend lint && pnpm run --filter babvr-register-page-frontend lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run --filter babvr-register-page-backend lint:fix && pnpm run --filter babvr-register-page-frontend lint:fix
